purpose: Test whether Draw Top1 failure is primarily caused by three-way argmax geometry by replacing it with three strictly-prior pairwise H-D, D-A and H-A classifiers on a tenth deterministic 100-match sample disjoint from all previously consumed samples.

algorithm.family: three pairwise binary logits with deterministic Borda-style pairwise win score
algorithm.features: the same frozen nine-dimensional pre-match feature vector from R39U, no new information family

models.H_vs_D: fit only strictly-prior H/D rows; target y=1 for H
models.D_vs_A: fit only strictly-prior D/A rows; target y=1 for D
models.H_vs_A: fit only strictly-prior H/A rows; target y=1 for H

algorithm.standardization: median/IQR fitted separately inside each pairwise target model from its own strictly-prior training rows
algorithm.solver: deterministic Newton/IRLS with backtracking line search
algorithm.top1: maximum pairwise-win score; exact ties use A then H then D so there is no Draw tie preference

baseline.name: exact R39W two-stage Draw + conditional H/A Top1 on the same sample

frozen_gate.if_pass: Decision geometry is a credible Draw Top1 mechanism and may proceed to a separately preregistered probability-coupling/rolling experiment; no formal promotion.
frozen_gate.if_fail: Stop pairwise geometry route; no post-result L2/score/threshold tuning on the tenth sample.
